caller_is_owner.meaning: the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is the onlyOwner authority

deadline_enforced.meaning: the liquidity increase transaction carries a caller-provided deadline that expires and prevents execution after that deadline (deadline expiration protection active)
deadline_enforced.checkpoint: at execution of the liquidity increase transaction

assumptions: The liquidity increase transaction is initiated by the onlyOwner caller of L2TokenReceiverV2.
The deadline expiration protection is the caller-provided deadline semantics described in intent_deadline_expiry.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete caller-provided deadline value or the numeric relation between block.timestamp and that deadline; the deadline_enforced observable is a qualitative Boolean for later code binding.

limitations: Only the expiration-disabled impact is formalized; indefinite-hold, MEV arbitrage profit, and financial-loss impacts are handled in separate passes.
The deadline_enforced symbol is a qualitative Boolean because the report states the deadline purpose but no numeric deadline definition.
